A real Vietnamese Restaurant
Mar 2013 • Friends
Located just outside the city centre (about 25,000VND taxi fare from the Caravelle Hotel), this gem of a restaurant provides ample seating in a typical Vietnamese "Mans'" eatery.

The food is good, beer usually served warm over ice (ask them to put extra bottles into a bucket of ice), huge selection of all types of foods, 

Waitresses are stunning and friendly and enjoy interacting with locals and tourists (which are few and far between) and provide great service (generally a couple are allocated to each table).

A great experience.

WOW!!!!
Aug 2011 • Friends
Now this is a big and very authentic vietnamese restaurant that is filled to bursting with locals. We were the only tourists there, the staff speak very little english, the beer is served with ice to make it cold and there is no air-conditioning . But the food, mostly seafood, is sensational and the prices are the cheapest i've seen in Saigon. But the waitresses are out of this world. There are probably 40-50 waitresses working there, and they're doing everything from peeling your prawns by hand to lighting customers cigarettes. Do yourself a favour and try this place out.
